{{Quote|Andurgo! Stop toying with that predator! Our target is the ion cannon on Moon Twelve! We have to hit it before they get their force field up!|Monia Gahan|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
'''Moon Twelve''' was the name used by [[Monia Gahan]] to refer to the twelfth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. One of the [[Planet/Legends|world's]]<ref name="Legacy 36" /> twenty-eight moons,<ref name="Into the Core" /> it had a rocky surface on which the forces of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] had established an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]]. In that year, [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] [[Coruscant Third Fleet]] was [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attacked]] over Ralltiir by the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] and [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] which saw Gahan and [[Andurgo]], both [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the legendary [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], destroy the moon's ion [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] before it could be protected by a [[Force field/Legends|force field]].<ref name="Legacy 36" />
